tenure.coverage: England and Wales only (Census 2021 TS054); not UK-wide

source.title: Census 2021 TS054 Tenure of household (Nomis dataset NM_2072_1), England and Wales
source.publisher: Office for National Statistics via Nomis

tenure.notes: Derived from household counts (24,783,199): outright 8,136,782; mortgage/loan 7,122,199 plus shared ownership 240,234; private rented 5,023,531 (landlord/agency plus other private rented); social rented 4,227,756; lives rent free 32,697. Households not persons: persons in rent/social housing are somewhat over-represented in the adult population, so independent sampling of adults from household shares is an approximation.

economic_activity.coverage: England and Wales only (Census 2021 TS066); not UK-wide

source.title: Census 2021 TS066 Economic activity status (Nomis dataset NM_2083_1), England and Wales
source.publisher: Office for National Statistics via Nomis

economic_activity.notes: Derived: employed = 26,960,268 (not students) + 813,397 (full-time students in employment), includes self-employed; unemployed = 1,376,363 + 298,822 (full-time students unemployed); 'student' is only the economically inactive students (2,740,634), so working or job-seeking students are counted as employed/unemployed. Retired 10,513,713; looking after home/family 2,317,340; long-term sick/disabled 2,025,621; other inactive 1,520,213. Total 48,566,371. Includes 16-17s, so slightly more students than an 18+ pool; Census was taken during Covid restrictions (furlough counted as employed).

qualification.coverage: England and Wales only (Census 2021 TS067); not UK-wide

source.title: Census 2021 TS067 Highest level of qualification (Nomis dataset NM_2084_1), England and Wales
source.publisher: Office for National Statistics via Nomis

qualification.notes: Derived: level_1_2 = Level 1 and entry (4,679,223) + Level 2 (6,493,490). Total 48,566,373. Includes 16-17s (who lower the average attainment slightly).

ethnicity.coverage: England and Wales only (Census 2021 TS021); Scotland and NI not fetched
ethnicity.unit: usual residents, all ages (not adults only)

source.title: Census 2021 TS021 Ethnic group (Nomis dataset NM_2041_1), England and Wales
source.publisher: Office for National Statistics via Nomis

ethnicity.notes: Derived: broad groups as ONS counts: White 48,699,249; Asian/Asian British/Asian Welsh 5,515,420; Black 2,409,278; Mixed/Multiple 1,717,976; Other (incl Arab) 1,255,619; total 59,597,542. All-ages shares: adults are less diverse than children, so adult non-White share is a little lower. Scotland and NI censuses (2022) use different category sets and were not used.

vote_2024.coverage: UK (parties' GB votes plus all UK votes; NI parties inside 'other')

source.title: Results for the UK general election on 4 July 2024 (candidacies CSV, Great Britain and England/Scotland/Wales; UK electorate and valid votes)
source.publisher: House of Commons Library, Election Results

vote_2024.notes: Derived: each party's UK votes divided by UK electorate 48,224,212. Votes: Lab 9,708,716; Con 6,828,925; Reform 4,117,610; LD 3,519,143; Green 1,935,809 (Green Party 1,843,124 + Scottish Green 92,685, from GB candidacies CSV); SNP 724,758; Plaid 194,811; other = residual 1,779,568 (independents, Speaker, Workers Party, NI parties, minor parties). Valid votes 28,809,340 = 59.74% of electorate (the official 59.7% turnout); did_not_vote = 1 - that = 40.3% (spoiled ballots, 116,253, are counted in did_not_vote; including them turnout would be 59.98%). Caveat: the electorate is registered voters, not all adults, so true non-voting among adults (incl unregistered, non-citizens ineligible) is higher/different. Greens/other split checked against the CSV: GB 'Green' 1,935,809.
